Hero_Desc_Erpin:
Queen of the sprites.
She is a sucker for sweet desserts. Although she can seem hopeless at times and she isn't perfect, she is a sprite who tries her best in her own way.
No matter how rude she is, you just can't hate her.
Album_Like_Erpin: The chewy chocolate part of a chocolate ice cream cake. Her queen throne.
Album_Hate_Erpin: All food such as vegetables and meat, except baked goods. Responsibilities as a queen.
Album_Wish_Erpin: Becoming the respected queen of the Sprite Kingdom without efforts. Eating a fantastical 33 meter cake.
Album_Erpin1: Although Erpin is the queen of the sprites in Elias Forest, her immaturity is bit unbecoming for someone of her royal status. Even so, she seems... to genuinely care for the forest's wellbeing...
Album_Erpin2: Perhaps it's because of Erpin's flighty personality, but the sprites don't seem to take their queen very seriously. Treating her as if she was basically a figurehead, Erpin wants to prove her worth as the 'true queen.'
Album_Erpin3: Awhile back, I overheard Erpin talking in her sleep, saying this like "equitable distribution of cakes to all." When she awoke, I asked her about this bizarre theory, to which I endured a two-hour lecture on her half-baked 'fair cake distribution' theory. The fact it was followed up with a four-hour rambling rebuttal was just the icing on the cake.
Album_Erpin4: Erpin once left a note and ran off on an adventure for three years, under the guise of finding an ancient relic to prove her worth as queen. When she returned, she brought back a collection of unusual goods, piled up the royal warehouse, and which Ner refers to as trash.
Album_Erpin5: Erpin sometimes proudly displays her tra-... I mean, goods, that are piled up in the warehouse. They appear to be ordinary-looking rocks and rotting wood panels... I tried my best to smile, complimenting her on her achievements.
Album_Erpin6: Erpin claims the goods hold precious memories. Curious, I asked whose memories it contained, she mentioned they were toys she played with that belonged to someone dear to her. She then changed the subject.
Album_Erpin7: I heard something astonishing. Apparently, Erpin and Belita, the queen of the witches who live the opposite kind of life from the sprites, are actually sisters. At birth, they were assigned to rule over Elias's surface and underground, which led to their estrangement. Maybe the items Erpin once showed me in her warehouse were mementos of her memories with Belita?

LoveCall_Erpin:
Ah~ Hello~ Hmm~ I did not call because anything happened...

I was eating bread and suddenly wanted to hear your voice, so I called! Well, that is what happened! I am a queen too, so I can make a call like this, right?

Umm... It really is okay, right? Well, your opinion is not that important, Master. With phone calls, the feelings of the person who wants to call matter more.

Are you busy right now? I did not call while you were busy, did I? Uh, if you were busy, sorry...

If you do not have to hang up right away, stay on the phone with me just a little longer. I called because I wanted to hear your voice, Master.

The Order and the palace are pretty far apart, so I miss you a lot.

You used to stay right beside me and teach me all sorts of things. These days, you are busy and I have gotten busy too, so it feels harder to see each other.

Hmm, so... let us definitely go on a picnic together sometime, okay?

Do not keep turning me down just because you are busy! I want to have fun with you!

We really will meet up sometime, right? Hehe! I will talk to Ner and arrange the schedule!

Keep up the good work, Master!
